description: This file declares the SpectrumInquiryTask class which manages the creation and sending of spectrum inquiry messages within the beerocks slave thread context. It includes methods for creating messages and adding relevant TLVs related to spectrum inquiry, with references to external TLV and message classes.

classes.name: SpectrumInquiryTask
classes.description: A class responsible for creating and sending available spectrum inquiry messages in the spectrum management system.

methods.name: SpectrumInquiryTask
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SpectrumInquiryTask with context and message objects.

methods.name: create_available_spectrum_inquiry_message
methods.description: Creates and packs the spectrum inquiry message into the specified message object.

methods.name: prepare_available_spectrum_inquiry_message
methods.description: Prepares the spectrum inquiry message, likely including TLV additions.

methods.name: add_available_spectrum_inquiry_request_tlv
methods.description: Adds the spectrum inquiry request TLV to the message.

methods.name: add_available_spectrum_inquiry_response_tlv
methods.description: Adds the spectrum inquiry response TLV to the message.
